introduction: SC Thrive helps people screen for benefits and complete applications through its support service and Thrive Hub. Agencies still decide program eligibility.
description: SC Thrive helps people screen for benefits and complete applications through its support service and Thrive Hub. Agencies still decide program eligibility.

sections.who: The relevant benefit’s rules determine eligibility. Tell SC Thrive which household members need help and what you have already applied for.
sections.get: Assistance includes food-benefit applications, healthcare screening and other support. It also advertises free tax-filing services subject to its service rules.
sections.docs:
• Household members and income.
  • Existing benefits and application notices.
  • Documents requested for the particular program.
sections.apply:
1. Contact SC Thrive

    Call 800-726-8774 or use the Thrive Hub account link.

  2. Identify the benefit

    Explain the need so staff can screen the appropriate options.

  3. Complete the actual application

    Keep agency confirmation and respond to agency follow-up requests.
sections.after: Track the agency decision separately from a Thrive Hub account. Ask for help understanding missing-document requests.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SC Thrive services and contact. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
